plan.title: Single-stage RFP mandatory terms accepted by vendor

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Keep the event type as RFP.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply a questionnaire template to the RFP.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFP create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", enable "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory", click Done, and stop on the create screen showing both clauses as "Overridden by Mark all mandatory"

steps.note: Configure the two mandatory clauses, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Verify the mandatory override is visible after configuring the clauses.
a product is needed before participants or publishing
Invite one available QA vendor for the submission.
Commit the 30-minute schedule required for publishing.
Publish the configured RFP.
Verify the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's RFP questionnaire as the vendor.
Verify the first mandatory clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the second mandatory clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept the first mandatory clause.
Accept the second mandatory clause.
Fill the technical questionnaire so the vendor can submit.
Submit the vendor's accepted technical response.
Assert that the vendor submission was accepted.
Return to the buyer's event page.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer sees confirmation that the bidding vendor accepted the terms.
